contentPattern.structure: intro + masonry grid of social post cards (avatar/name/network, text with show-more, optional image or video media, time + external link)

suitableFor: social media feed / post card grids

notes: Author-managed masonry card grid matching the live RWE social feed. Row 1 = intro (heading + copy); each following row = one post card. A cell may contain a <picture> (wrap in a link to mark it a video), post text, and a final link whose text is the relative time and whose href is the external post URL. The 'live' variant additionally mounts a consent-gated Flockler feed container (wired by the site's consent-management layer), keeping the authored cards as the no-consent fallback. Icons sourced from the RWE UI Kit.
